description_en: Adds a personal drive for a user in an enterprise network drive
description_zh: 在企业网盘中添加用户个人盘
kebab_example: aliyun ecd create-cloud-drive-users --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cds-id cn-hangzhou+cds-3522820000 --user-max-size 209715200 --end-user-id alice --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCloudDriveUsers

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum storage capacity of the user's personal drive. This value cannot exceed the remaining allocatable capacity of the enterprise network drive. Unit: bytes
parameters.help_zh: 用户个人盘的存储峰值。该值不可大于企业网盘中可分配的剩余容量。单位：Byte（字节）
parameters.name: user_max_size

parameters.help_en: The list of end user IDs
parameters.name: end_user_id
